expected_output: Badge gains a size prop, and both color and size map to complete, statically written Tailwind class names -- a lookup table or branching that returns full class strings -- instead of a template literal that completes a utility name with an interpolated value, which Tailwind's scanner never sees. A complete Tailwind text-size utility class appears as a literal token
